name: Sammiana I2
description_md:
Sammiana I2 is a hard waymarked hiking route located in MK. The distance is 195.6 km and it is part of the national waymarked hiking network.

The trail includes 7761 m of ascent and 8226 m of descent. Walking time is about 70 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent.
